inputRootSignature: theorem extrinsic_sample_mean_on_unit_sphere (d n : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, dotProduct (x i) (x i) = 1) : let xBar : Fin d → ℝ := (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, x i xBar ≠ 0 → let objective : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ := fun p ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, dotProduct (x i - p) (x i - p) {p : Fin d → ℝ | dotProduct p p = 1 ∧ ∀ q, dotProduct q q = 1 → objective p ≤ objective q} = {((Real.sqrt (dotProduct xBar xBar))⁻¹ : ℝ) • xBar}
